# vantage_virtual_tag_config_value (Resource)

Manages an individual virtual tag config value.

Provide one allocation mode: `name`, `business_metric_token`, `cost_metric`, or a non-empty `percentages` list.

~> **Value ownership:** Manage values either with separate `vantage_virtual_tag_config_value` resources OR inline with the parent `vantage_virtual_tag_config.values` attribute, never both for the same config. When using this resource, omit `values` from the parent; parent updates will not modify or remove these values. No `ignore_changes` setting is needed.

Omitted optional attributes retain their API values. To clear a stored list, set it to `[]`; to clear label filters, set `label_filters = {}`. These changes replace only this value because the value update endpoint cannot clear them. Changing the parent config token also requires replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vantage_virtual_tag_config" "allocation" {
  key         = "Cost Center"
  overridable = false
}

resource "vantage_virtual_tag_config_value" "engineering" {
  virtual_tag_config_token = vantage_virtual_tag_config.allocation.token
  filter                   = "costs.provider = 'aws'"
  name                     = "Engineering"
}

resource "vantage_virtual_tag_config_value" "shared" {
  virtual_tag_config_token = vantage_virtual_tag_config.allocation.token
  filter                   = "costs.provider = 'gcp'"
  display_name             = "Shared costs"
  percentages = [
    { value = "Engineering", pct = 75 },
    { value = "Support", pct = 25 },
  ]
  date_ranges = [
    { start_date = "2026-01-01", end_date = null },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `filter` (String) The filter query language to apply to the value. Additional documentation available at https://docs.vantage.sh/vql.
- `virtual_tag_config_token` (String) The token of the parent virtual tag config. Changing this forces replacement.

### Optional

- `business_metric_token` (String) The token of an associated business metric.
- `cost_metric` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cost_metric))
- `date_ranges` (Attributes List) Date ranges restricting when this value applies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--date_ranges))
- `display_name` (String) The display name for a cost metric or percentage allocation value.
- `label_filters` (Map of List of String) Business metric row filters. Each key must match, and values within a key are alternatives. Cannot include the fan-out `label_key`. Setting an existing non-empty map to `{}` replaces this value to clear the filters.
- `label_key` (String) The business metric label key used for this virtual tag value.
- `label_transforms` (Attributes List) Label transforms applied to business metric labels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--label_transforms))
- `label_values` (List of String) Business metric label values. An empty array includes every value for the label key.
- `name` (String) The name of the value.
- `percentages` (Attributes List) Labeled percentage allocations for matching costs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--percentages))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the virtual tag config value
- `token` (String) The token of the virtual tag config value

Required:

- `aggregation` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cost_metric--aggregation))
- `filter` (String) The filter VQL for the cost metric.

### Nested Schema for `cost_metric.aggregation`

Required:

- `tag` (String) The tag to aggregate on.



<a id="nestedatt--date_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `date_ranges`

Optional:

- `end_date` (String) The end date of the range (inclusive), or null for unbounded.
- `start_date` (String) The start date of the range (inclusive), or null for unbounded.


<a id="nestedatt--label_transforms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `label_transforms`

Required:

- `type` (String) The label transform type.

Optional:

- `delimiter` (String) Delimiter used by split transforms.
- `index` (Number) Zero-based index used by split transforms.
- `template` (String) Template used by format transforms.


<a id="nestedatt--percentages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `percentages`

Required:

- `pct` (Number)
- `value` (String) The tag value associated with a percentage of matched costs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vantage_virtual_tag_config_value.engineering vtag_1234/vtag_val_5678
```
